- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Add opt-in CPU staging for plain BF16 parameters during distributed-optimizer DDP initialization, reducing the overlap between old parameter storage and new contiguous GPU buffers.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: Fixes #8832

## Details

`DistributedDataParallelConfig.ddp_cpu_staging` defaults to `False`. When enabled together with `use_distributed_optimizer`, plain BF16 CUDA parameters move synchronously to CPU after buffer layout/compatibility checks and before contiguous buffers are allocated. Existing remapping restores their values into GPU buffer views and preserves `Parameter` identity, including tied references.

FP32, FP16, TE quantized and grouped storage use the existing initialization path. The new option is a Core config API; this PR does not add a training CLI argument. The documented tradeoff is temporary host memory and extra synchronous transfers during initialization.

### Measured memory tradeoff

A bounded 2-rank H200 experiment uses 1 GiB BF16 parameters and FP32 main gradients per rank. Both ranks give:

| Measurement | Existing initialization | CPU staging |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Peak allocated CUDA memory | 4 GiB | 3 GiB |
| Final allocated CUDA memory | 3 GiB | 3 GiB |
| Additional sampled host RSS | about 1 MiB | about 1 GiB |
| Synchronized constructor duration, one sample | about 5.3 ms | about 738 ms |

All initialized parameter values are exactly preserved. RSS was sampled every 2 ms. These numbers describe an allocation tradeoff on a small model, not training throughput or a full-model performance claim.

## Validation

Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.14.1+cu132, Transformer Engine 2.20.2+6ea2a74, H200:

```bash
# New targeted coverage: 9 passed per rank on 2 GPUs.
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 python -m torch.distributed.run \
  --master-addr=127.0.0.1 --master-port=29801 --nproc-per-node=2 \
  -m pytest -q tests/unit_tests/distributed/test_ddp_cpu_staging.py

# Wider coverage: 74 passed per rank on 8 GPUs.
python -m torch.distributed.run \
  --master-addr=127.0.0.1 --master-port=29802 --nproc-per-node=8 \
  -m pytest -q tests/unit_tests/distributed/test_ddp_cpu_staging.py \
  tests/unit_tests/distributed/test_param_and_grad_buffer.py \
  -k "DDPCPUStaging or bucket_sizes or NVFP4IndexMaps"
```

- Two actual distributed Adam updates: initialized values, gradient buffers and updated parameters match baseline bit-exactly for BF16/FP32 main gradients and overlap on/off.
- Stable `Parameter` identity, tied weights, multiple buckets and a no-op without distributed optimizer.
- Real TE FP8 and grouped BF16 parameters retain values and specialized storage behavior. NVFP4 index-map regressions pass; direct NVFP4 GPU-storage coverage requires a compatible accelerator and was not run on H200.
- Disabling staging in the production runtime makes the peak-memory regression fail as expected on both ranks.
- `tools/autoformat.sh` black/isort/pylint/ruff gates passed. Mypy remains advisory in that script and reports existing typing/import-stub errors in the isolated lint environment; a clean type-check result is not claimed.

No full-model, 32-node, or checkpoint-resume run was performed on this upstream revision.

## Code provenance

Implemented independently in the Megatron-LM fork from the upstream base above. No code was copied from an external repository. Existing license and copyright notices are retained. Implementation, tests and this description were prepared with AI coding assistance; the author review checkbox remains unchecked pending human review.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel, I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in the kernel manifest
- [x] I have added proper typing to the new config and test signatures
- [x] I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run `tools/autoformat.sh` on my PR

The two-step distributed Adam coverage lives in unit tests. No GPU kernel, numeric operation, or external-library dispatch is introduced or changed, so kernel determinism registration does not apply.

@@ -21,6 +21,14 @@ Theoretical memory savings depend on the data types of the model parameters (`pa
 
 This distributed optimizer uses contiguous buffers for parameters and main gradients. Model gradients copy into the main gradients as soon as they finish computing.
 
+To reduce the GPU memory peak while these buffers are allocated, set
+`ddp_cpu_staging=True` in `DistributedDataParallelConfig` together with
+`use_distributed_optimizer=True`. Plain BF16 CUDA parameters temporarily move to
+CPU, then return to GPU as views of the contiguous parameter buffer. This option
+is disabled by default and trades temporary host memory and synchronous device
+copies for less overlap between old parameter storage and new buffers. FP32,
+quantized and grouped parameters retain their existing initialization path.
+
 Models may retain selected parameters in `fp32` alongside `fp16` or `bf16` weights,
 as mHC does. Optimizer checkpoint lookups follow the main-parameter group order
 (native `fp32` shards, then low-precision master shards), independently of the

@@ -35,6 +35,14 @@ class DistributedDataParallelConfig:
        originally allocated model parameters, otherwise issue all-reduce collectives.
     """
 
+    ddp_cpu_staging: bool = False
+    """Temporarily move plain BF16 CUDA parameters to CPU before allocating DDP buffers.
+
+    Requires ``use_distributed_optimizer``. Trades host memory and synchronous copies
+    for a lower initialization GPU memory peak. FP32, quantized and grouped parameters
+    retain their existing initialization path. Has no effect after initialization.
+    """

     num_distributed_optimizer_instances: int = 1
     """Sets the factor by which the DP domain is sharded to have the partial DistOpt
        enabled. Defaults to 1, which means DistOpt is across entire DP domain.

@@ -1218,6 +1218,23 @@ def __init__(
                 "parameter and gradient data share storage."
             )
 
+        if ddp_config.ddp_cpu_staging and ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer:
+            staged_bytes = 0
+            for param in self.params:
+                if (
+                    param.is_cuda
+                    and param.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+                    and not is_grouped_tensor(param)
+                    and not _param_uses_quantized_storage(param)
+                ):
+                    assert param.data._base is None, "DDP CPU staging requires viewless parameters"
+                    staged_bytes += param.numel() * param.element_size()
+                    param.data = param.detach().to("cpu")
+            if staged_bytes:
+                torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+                if self.is_buffer_log_rank:

+# Copyright (c) 2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
+
+import gc
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core.distributed import DistributedDataParallel, DistributedDataParallelConfig
+from megatron.core.fp8_utils import is_float8tensor, is_grouped_tensor
+from megatron.core.optimizer import OptimizerConfig, get_megatron_optimizer
+from megatron.core.transformer import TransformerConfig
+from tests.unit_tests.test_utilities import Utils
+
+
+class StagingModel(torch.nn.Module):
+    """BF16 weights with tied storage through the same Parameter and an FP32 parameter."""
+
+    def __init__(self, size: int) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weights = torch.nn.ParameterList(
+            [
+                torch.nn.Parameter(torch.full((size,), 0.5, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+                for _ in range(4)
+            ]
+        )
+        self.tied_weight = self.weights[0]
+        self.scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32))
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return sum(weight[:16].float().sum() for weight in self.weights) * x * self.scale
+
+
+class TestDDPCPUStaging:
+    """Compare DDP allocation peaks and actual distributed Adam updates."""
+
+    def setup_method(self) -> None:
+        Utils.initialize_model_parallel()
+
+    def teardown_method(self) -> None:
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("grad_reduce_in_fp32", [False, True])
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("overlap", [False, True])
+    def test_parameter_gradient_and_adam_equivalence(
+        self, grad_reduce_in_fp32: bool, overlap: bool
+    ) -> None:
+        results = []
+        for staging in (False, True):
+            model = StagingModel(4096)
+            parameter_ids = [id(param) for param in model.parameters()]
+            ddp_config = DistributedDataParallelConfig(
+                use_distributed_optimizer=True,
+                ddp_cpu_staging=staging,
+                grad_reduce_in_fp32=grad_reduce_in_fp32,
+                overlap_grad_reduce=overlap,
+                overlap_param_gather=overlap,
+                bucket_size=4096,
+            )
+            ddp = DistributedDataParallel(
+                TransformerConfig(num_attention_heads=1, num_layers=1), ddp_config, model
+            )
+            assert parameter_ids == [id(param) for param in ddp.parameters()]
+            assert model.tied_weight is model.weights[0]
+            for buffer in ddp.buffers:
+                for param in buffer.params:
+                    assert param.is_cuda
+                    assert (
+                        param.untyped_storage().data_ptr()
+                        == buffer.param_data.untyped_storage().data_ptr()
+                    )
+            initial = [param.detach().cpu().clone() for param in ddp.parameters()]
+            optimizer = get_megatron_optimizer(
+                OptimizerConfig(
+                    optimizer="adam",
+                    lr=0.1,
+                    bf16=True,
+                    use_distributed_optimizer=True,
+                    use_precision_aware_optimizer=False,
+                    clip_grad=0.0,
+                    weight_decay=0.0,
+                ),
+                [ddp],
+            )
+            step_results = []
+            for _ in range(2):
+                optimizer.zero_grad()
+                ddp.zero_grad_buffer()
+                ddp(torch.tensor([Utils.rank + 1.0], device="cuda")).sum().backward()
+                ddp.finish_grad_sync()
+                grads = [buffer.grad_data.detach().cpu().clone() for buffer in ddp.buffers]
+                successful, _, _ = optimizer.step()
+                assert successful
+                ddp.start_param_sync(force_sync=True)
+                torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                step_results.append(
+                    (grads, [param.detach().cpu().clone() for param in ddp.parameters()])
+                )
+            assert not torch.equal(initial[0], step_results[-1][1][0])
+            results.append((initial, step_results))
+            del optimizer, ddp, model
+            gc.collect()
+        for baseline, staged in zip(results[0][0], results[1][0]):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(baseline, staged, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        for baseline_step, staged_step in zip(results[0][1], results[1][1]):
+            for baseline_values, staged_values in zip(baseline_step, staged_step):
+                for baseline, staged in zip(baseline_values, staged_values):
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(baseline, staged, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+    def test_initialization_memory_peak(self) -> None:
+        peaks = []
+        final_allocations = []
+        parameter_bytes = 4 * 8 * 1024 * 1024 * 2
+        for staging in (False, True):
+            gc.collect()
+            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+            model = StagingModel(8 * 1024 * 1024)
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
+            ddp = DistributedDataParallel(
+                TransformerConfig(num_attention_heads=1, num_layers=1),
+                DistributedDataParallelConfig(
+                    use_distributed_optimizer=True,
+                    ddp_cpu_staging=staging,
+                    grad_reduce_in_fp32=True,
+                ),
+                model,
+            )
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            peaks.append(torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated())
+            final_allocations.append(torch.cuda.memory_allocated())
+            del ddp, model
+        # Small FP32 buffers and CUDA bookkeeping can add allocator-sized blocks.
+        assert peaks[0] - peaks[1] >= parameter_bytes - 4096
+        assert abs(final_allocations[0] - final_allocations[1]) <= 4096
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float32])
+    def test_without_distributed_optimizer(self, dtype: torch.dtype) -> None:
+        model = torch.nn.Linear(16, 16, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+        pointers = [param.data_ptr() for param in model.parameters()]
+        ddp = DistributedDataParallel(
+            TransformerConfig(num_attention_heads=1, num_layers=1),
+            DistributedDataParallelConfig(ddp_cpu_staging=True),
+            model,
+        )
+        assert pointers == [param.data_ptr() for param in ddp.parameters()]
+        assert all(param.is_cuda for param in ddp.parameters())
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["fp8", "grouped"])
+    def test_specialized_parameter_storage(
+        self, kind: str, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+    ) -> None:
+        if kind == "fp8":
+            import transformer_engine_torch as tex
+            from transformer_engine.pytorch.tensor.float8_tensor import Float8Quantizer
+
+            quantizer = Float8Quantizer(
+                torch.ones(1, device="cuda"),
+                torch.zeros(1, device="cuda"),
+                tex.DType.kFloat8E4M3,
+                rowwise=True,
+                columnwise=False,
+            )
+            parameter = torch.nn.Parameter(
+                quantizer(torch.ones(16, 16, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+            )
+            assert is_float8tensor(parameter)
+            model = torch.nn.Module()
+            model.register_parameter("weight", parameter)
+            expected = parameter.detach().float().cpu()
+        else:
+            from transformer_engine.pytorch.module import GroupedLinear
+
+            monkeypatch.setenv("NVTE_GROUPED_LINEAR_SINGLE_PARAM", "1")
+            model = GroupedLinear(
+                2,
+                16,
+                16,
+                bias=False,
+                params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                single_grouped_weight=True,
+                use_grouped_tensor=True,
+            )
+            parameter = model.weight
+            assert is_grouped_tensor(parameter)
+            expected = parameter.rowwise_data.detach().cpu().clone()
+
+        ddp = DistributedDataParallel(
+            TransformerConfig(num_attention_heads=1, num_layers=1),
+            DistributedDataParallelConfig(use_distributed_optimizer=True, ddp_cpu_staging=True),
+            model,
+        )
+        assert any(param is parameter for param in ddp.parameters())
+        actual = (
+            parameter.detach().float().cpu()
+            if kind == "fp8"
+            else parameter.rowwise_data.detach().cpu()
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
